verdict.rationale: Increase documents creating both virtual and physical cards from signup, plus unlimited virtual cards. Spend control comes through real-time authorization decisions sent by webhook, which you approve or decline from your own servers. Nothing in the pack covers digital wallets, explicit account-to-card linkage or built-in spend-limit rules. missing for 10: digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) provisioning evidence, explicit card-to-account linkage docs, configurable spend limits beyond real-time decisioning, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, accounts come with cards — issue virtual and physical debit cards tied to the account through the same API, with spend controls and digital wallet support

citations.quote: You can start creating virtual and physical Increase cards as soon as you sign up.
